en-GB.name: Beneath Ashen Tor
en-GB.summary: A dice-rolling gamebook adventure you play by voice.
en-GB.description: Roll your skill, stamina and luck, then descend beneath Ashen Tor to recover the Dawnstone from the necromancer Malgrath. Choose your path, fight monsters round by round, test your luck, and manage your provisions and potion. Your game is saved as you play.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Say 'Alexa, open ashen tor'. Accept the rolled scores with 'yes', pick a potion ('strength'), then choose options by number. In fights say 'attack', 'test my luck' or 'escape'.
